name: Chapbook of Terrors
text:
This lurid pamphlet contains spooky tales about ghosts, monsters, and murderers, all illustrated in gruesome detail. The stories, fortunately, are only fictions… or are they?

Activate—Horrify 1 (concentrate, mental, spellshape)

Frequency once per day

---
Effect If your next action is to Cast a prepared Spell with the fear trait, creatures frightened by the spell also take 1d6 persistent,mental damage as they dwell on your terrifying tale.
